name: Notional V1 Escrow uint128 truncation in free-collateral ETH conversion
summary: Notional V1 Escrow.convertBalancesToETH (ExchangeRate._convertToETH) casts abs(balance) to uint128 without a bound check, so a net currency balance of -2^128 converts to 0 ETH. Via public ERC1155Trade.safeTransferFrom fCash pair mints the attacker made one account owe exactly 2^128 DAI fCash while passing the free-collateral check, used the unbacked 2^128-1 receiver leg as collateral to mint matured DAI/USDC claims sized to the escrow balances, then settled and withdrew all DAI and USDC from the escrow.
notes: The first of two Upgraded events on the Escrow proxy selected Escrow implementation 0x8a134e65, which inlines the truncating ExchangeRate._convertToETH; the second (block 25901449, the post-incident fix) follows the exploit.

Exact escrow depletion in source-3: the Escrow proxy's entire DAI and USDC balances. The attacker supplied no tokens (source-1 moves no ERC-20). WETH and WBTC held by the escrow were not taken by the attacker. A third-party liquidation at block 25900571 is excluded (liquidator paid USDC for WETH collateral).
